objective: Pre-register the next valid trading-day D06 evidence capture so data-quality and PIT gates are frozen before any return/outcome inspection.
globalGuards: Capture raw parent receipts before creating derived research states.
Every source family keeps sourceDate, producedAtContract when documented, requestAt, capturedAt, firstKnownAt, sourceVersion/schemaFingerprint, contentHash, parseStatus, coverage and unknownReasons.
UNKNOWN is never coerced to zero, BAD, no-event or no-flow.
Later finalized/revised data never overwrite an earlier vintage; append vintages.
A derived state becomes decision-time eligible only after the maximum firstKnownAt of all required parents.
No D1/D3/D5/D10/D20, MFE, MAE, return, hit-rate or selection outcome is joined during capture/readiness validation.
No Formal score, weight, threshold, rank, Top6, BUY/ADD/REDUCE/SELL or capital behavior changes.

lanes.purpose: Prospectively preserve dealer proprietary versus hedge split rather than only aggregate dealerNet.
parents: TPEx equivalent split fields when source semantics verify
lanes.passGate: At least one genuine prospective trading date with actor/desk split preserved, source schema verified and aggregate reconciliation passing.
lanes.maturityEffect: No automatic L4; this only opens prospective Shadow accumulation.

lanes.purpose: Attach TDCC ownership vintage lineage to the same research generation that consumes chip concentration.
lanes.passGate: Same-generation immutable chipAsOfDate/chipDefinition/hash preserved for prospective rows; repeated scan dates sharing one chipAsOfDate are deduplicated as one ownership vintage.
lanes.maturityEffect: Necessary for D06-05 L3/L4 path; holder identity and passive share remain UNKNOWN.

lanes.purpose: Build immutable CORE_CROWDING child only from PIT-eligible parent receipts.
lanes.passGate: All mandatory core parents PIT-eligible; optional leverage/day-trade/SBL/passive axes remain UNKNOWN when unavailable.
lanes.maturityEffect: Accumulates independent prospective evidence toward L4; no scalar crowding score.

lanes.purpose: Measure TPEx leverage/shorting source readiness and revision/finality rather than assuming one after-market timestamp.

captures.label: EARLY
captures.note: Attempt only through an authorized/free official route actually available on the trading date; record NOT_READY/UNKNOWN without retry-imputing values.

captures.label: LATE
captures.note: Repeat same source family to measure readiness/revision; do not treat later data as historically known at EARLY.

lanes.passGate: Product-specific TPEx official semantics and prospective readiness/revision demonstrated through an authorized route; paid source existence alone is insufficient.
lanes.maturityEffect: Can support L3 only when the specific source/semantics/replay gate for each module clears.

lanes.purpose: Preserve TPEx day-trading preliminary/revised/final vintages instead of backfilling final history.
vintages: T1_REVISED same trade date observed on T+1
T2_FINAL same trade date observed on T+2
lanes.passGate: At least one trade date followed through T/T+1/T+2 with append-only revision lineage and product-specific source semantics.
lanes.maturityEffect: Supports L3 readiness; 60% surveillance threshold remains regulatory context, not alpha threshold.

lanes.purpose: Capture a genuine independent-date ETF outstanding-unit change and same-generation PCF version.
lanes.sampleRule: Bounded domestic Taiwan-equity in-kind ETFs with provenance-complete issuer/TWSE source.
lanes.passGate: Second or later independent genuine trading date with units-delta and same-generation PCF provenance; operational adjustments/corporate actions explicitly handled.
lanes.maturityEffect: Supports D06-16 L3 readiness; does not prove actual same-day constituent execution or exact passive stock flow.

lanes.purpose: Prospectively capture TWSE public securities-lending rate/displayed-supply state with quote-persistence and rule-vintage metadata.
hardGuards: Displayed lend quantity is not verified total lendable inventory.
Do not compute true utilization without a verified lendable-inventory denominator.
Daily paid fee is not daily short demand.
Borrow and lend displayed quantities have asymmetric quote-age semantics.
lanes.passGate: One genuine prospective source receipt with transaction type and rule vintage preserved; L3 still requires sufficient replay/source parity rather than one isolated observation.

lanes.purpose: Continue source discovery without proxy substitution.
lanes.fallback: If no direct stock-date domestic-natural-person flow source exists, preserve only market/channel/ownership retail context and keep stock directional flow UNKNOWN.
lanes.passGate: L3 requires an authorized replayable Taiwan source contract for the declared core capability; academic historical access or private individual self-query does not equal a reusable research feed.

inferenceUnits.primary: independent scan/trade date for fast data; ownership-vintage cluster for TDCC
noPseudoReplication: multiple symbols on one date are not independent market-regime evidence
multiple scan dates sharing one TDCC as-of date are not independent ownership updates
multiple ETFs tracking one benchmark do not create independent benchmark events

exactNext: On the next valid Taiwan trading date, execute only the source/readiness captures whose authorized routes are available. Record unavailable lanes as UNKNOWN with blocker codes. Do not join outcomes until each lane's predefined readiness gate is evaluated.
